effect: Cells using this source will change appearance
undo: This file action is outside paint history. Pixel undo does not restore the PNG file. Edited copies and cell references are retained.
conflict: Different copies target the same source tile. Choose one or skip this tile.
empty: No applicable edited copies for this source.
road: Not applicable: generated provenance has no unambiguous original PNG rectangle.
missing: Not applicable: source or pixels are missing.
snapshot: Not applicable: backup images are read-only.
size: Not applicable: copy and source tile dimensions differ.
grid: Not applicable: source grid was not captured. Create a new pixel copy.
changed: The source PNG, grid or edits changed. The previous confirmation cannot be used. Reload to review current pixels or cancel.
reloaded: Current disk pixels loaded. Selected copies will replace pixels in this new source; review and confirm again.
readFailed: Could not read the PNG or world usages. Check files and access permissions.
writeFailed: Could not write the PNG. Check backup and file permissions, then review again.
success: PNG written; an exact backup of the original was retained.
gridChanged: Not applicable: the source grid changed; the original tile rectangle can no longer be verified.
saveFirst: Save the world to a folder first.
unsupportedProfile: This PNG color profile is not supported for lossless editing. The PNG was not changed.
unsupportedDepth: 16-bit PNG samples cannot be preserved losslessly. The PNG was not changed.
unsupportedAnimation: Animated PNG cannot be edited losslessly. The PNG was not changed.
unsupportedRepresentation: The chosen color or alpha cannot be represented losslessly in the source PNG palette or color type. The PNG was not changed.
unsupportedMetadata: This PNG contains additional data that cannot be preserved losslessly. The PNG was not changed.
